title: Improve the Index Mgmt page discoverability
summary: Index Management page now opens directly from search and table selection dialogs, with improved navigation from Table Information. DateTime minimum values display as dashes instead of actual dates.
key_points: Index Mgmt page can be opened directly from Tell Me search
Table selection dialog appears when opening the page without a context
Navigation button added from Table Information to Indexes List Part
DateTime.MinValue displays as dash instead of the actual minimum value
Page discoverability improved for direct access scenarios
quote: Change the design to support opening the page directly by showing a table selection dialog.
